conventions.coordinates: Metres, +Y up, model fronts face +Z. Each asset node has its origin at the centre of its footprint on the ground (y = 0); every root node has an identity transform (except skyline.glb, whose nodes carry a suggested world placement).
conventions.nodeLookup: Layout buildings map to node `${kind}_v${variant}`. Facilities that exist twice with different footprints (pump-station, water-tower) have one node per facility: resolve by assets[].facilityId first, then by kind + variant.
conventions.kitScaling: Kit buildings (tower-residential, tower-office, midrise-residential, lowrise-residential, villa, commercial-podium) are modelled at nominalSize [w, d, h] and tolerate non-uniform scaling of about +/-30% to the layout footprint/height. Facility, prop and underground assets are modelled at real size and placed unscaled.
conventions.glazing: Material "glazing" marks window surfaces for the scene's lit-window shader. UV0 on glazing encodes the window grid: v = storey coordinate (the lobby spans v 0..1, every storey above adds 1.0, aligned with the modelled slabs, so fract(v) is the position inside a storey even after non-uniform scaling); u = facade bay coordinate (1.0 per ~1.5-3 m bay, see assets[].notes). World-space window shaders also work.
conventions.vertexAO: Building, facility, underground and district-base meshes carry baked ambient occlusion in COLOR_0 (linear, ~0.38-1.0; the base has hand-placed gallery occlusion). On kit buildings the facade/facade_alt faces are additionally multiplied by a subtle per-variant stone tint (assets[].stoneTint: white, cream, beige or sand) so two stone materials give four tones. three.js GLTFLoader enables vertexColors automatically, which multiplies baseColor; keep vertexColors on any replacement material to keep the grounding and the tints.
conventions.compression: EXT_meshopt_compression (decode with GLTFLoader.setMeshoptDecoder(MeshoptDecoder) from three/examples/jsm/libs/meshopt_decoder.module.js). Normals are int16 and COLOR_0 uint8 (KHR_mesh_quantization); positions and UVs are float32.
conventions.emissive: Emissive materials ("emissive_sign", "light_emissive", "water") carry emissive colour/strength suitable for bloom; the scene may drive their intensity (e.g. night/outage states).
conventions.props: Props have their origin at the base on the ground. streetlight arms point along local +Z (layout rotation 0 = towards +Z / the road centre); palms are rotationally free and scale uniformly (layout scale 0.8-1.25); solar-array_v0 is a ~10 x 6 m rooftop rack whose modules face +Z (south).
conventions.skyline: skyline.glb node transforms carry a suggested placement (assets[].placement) with the tower bases at y = 0. If the background ground/sea is lower than the district surface, offset the whole skyline group to that level (the previews use y = -59).
conventions.pipes: Exposed mains are rendered by the scene from district.json routes. district-base gallery saddles and underground-kit flanges are sized for a visual pipe radius of 0.9 m (anchors.pipeVisualRadius).
conventions.provenance: All assets are original procedural geometry and textures generated for Encirra by the scripts in assets/blender/. No third-party models, textures or HDRIs are used.

materials.facade: Primary warm-white stone/render: walls, slabs, piers, balcony fronts.
materials.facade_alt: Secondary sand/beige stone: bands, alternate volumes, podiums.
materials.glazing: Facade glazing planes/bands; replaced in the scene by the lit-window shader. UV0 encodes the window grid: v = storey index (1.0 per storey, slab-aligned), u = bay index (1.0 per ~3 m bay).
materials.trim: Dark anodised aluminium: mullions, frames, louvres, copings, rails.
materials.accent: Bronze/champagne metal accents: fins, mashrabiya-style screens, signage bands.
materials.glass_clear: Clear glass (balustrades, canopies, tank level band); alpha blended.
materials.emissive_sign: Self-lit signage: hospital red cross and lettering.
materials.metal: Galvanised/bright steel: fences, gantries, rails, vents, ladders.
materials.steel_dark: Dark painted steel: transformers, machinery, frames, antenna masts.
materials.concrete: Cast concrete: plinths, slabs, galleries, pipe supports, paving.
materials.water: Water bodies (tank level column); faintly self-lit cyan.
materials.soil: Soil/rock strata on the district base cut faces (baked colour + normal textures).
materials.rock: Rock and gravel: bedrock underside, substation yard gravel.
materials.light_emissive: Warm lamp heads, aviation and helipad lights.
materials.pipe: Painted pipework and pump/valve bodies (industrial blue).
materials.valve_red: Red-painted valve handwheels, check-valve covers and fire equipment.

City Hospital: podium + ward tower, red cross and HOSPITAL lettering (emissive_sign), drop-off canopy, emergency canopy, rooftop helipad.

Substation S1 compound: two power transformers with radiator banks/conservators/bushings, firewalls, busbar gantries with insulator strings, breakers and disconnectors, control building, palisade fence and gate.

Pumping station PS-1. Child node 'pump_cutaway' sits below grade (y -27.6..-11.5, z +1..+12 local) in the district-base chamber: suction gate valve, end-suction pump + motor, check and gate valves, discharge riser. The suction main (y=-24) ends at the suction flange; the transmission main (y=-15) starts at the discharge flange (local x=0, z=+6).

Pumping station PS-2. Child node 'pump_cutaway_v1' sits below grade (y -27.6..-11.5, z +1..+12 local) in the district-base chamber: suction gate valve, end-suction pump + motor, check and gate valves, discharge riser. The suction main (y=-24) ends at the suction flange; the transmission main (y=-15) starts at the discharge flange (local x=0, z=+6).

Elevated tank TANK-T1. Child 'water_level' is the water column: origin at waterLevelMinY, height = waterLevelMaxY - waterLevelMinY at scale.y = 1; set scale.y = clamp(levelM / tankMaxLevelM, 0.001, 1). It is visible through the glass_clear band of the vessel.

Elevated tank TANK-T2. Child 'water_level_v1' is the water column: origin at waterLevelMinY, height = waterLevelMaxY - waterLevelMinY at scale.y = 1; set scale.y = clamp(levelM / tankMaxLevelM, 0.001, 1). It is visible through the glass_clear band of the vessel.

Desalination supply R1: three ground storage tanks, header and valves, pump/control building. Child 'intake_cutaway' drops the outlet riser into the base's R1 chamber and tees onto the suction main at (local) x=0, y=-24, z=+6.
District cooling plant DC-1: chiller hall with louvres, six rooftop cooling-tower cells with fan stacks, thermal storage tank and chilled-water pipework.
Emergency Operations Centre: robust stone civic block, glazed operations room, antenna mast with aviation light, satellite dishes, standby generator.
Retail mall: shopfront arcade, mashrabiya-screen upper mass, glass atrium with cantilevered canopy, barrel skylight.
Office complex: three-storey podium with two curtain-wall towers (62 m / 47 m) linked by a sky bridge.

Top face at y=0 (render roads/blocks >= 0.02 m above it or with polygonOffset). Strata faces are recessed 0.3 m under a 1.2 m concrete band. Galleries: front upper (transmission, pipe centre y=-15, z=152), front lower (suction, y=-24, z=152), west (transmission, y=-15, x=-242). Saddles are sized for a visual pipe radius of 0.9 m. COLOR_0 carries hand-placed occlusion for gallery interiors. Soil UVs: u = perimeter metres / 84 (seamless), v = (y + 42) / 40.8.
